title: code
description: A block of code, a log or command output in monospace, with copy, folding, and an optional result of running it.

kind.description: snippet: code with line numbers and syntax colour; log: lines with times and levels; output: what a command printed.

language.description: Syntax colour and the label on the block: swift, python, typescript, shell, json, sql, yaml, text. Not diff or patch: those go to the diff card or `diff`.

text.description: kind snippet and output: the code or output as plain text with \n line breaks. A log sends `lines` instead.

at.description: When it was written. Shown as the time of day (14:02:14) in the log’s own offset.

level.description: The level, always shown as a word (INFO, WARN, ERROR). warning is orange, error and critical red; the others are secondary text. Omit when the line has none.

source.description: Which process or service wrote it, when the log mixes several: api, worker, cron.

text.description: The line as written, without its time and level.

repeat.description: The same line came this many times in a row. Shown once with “×12” (a folded repeat); a tap expands it on this device.

lines.description: kind log: the lines, oldest first. The block opens at the tail.

counts.description: kind log: how many lines of each level the covered stretch of the log had (the title says which: “last 15 minutes”), including lines not sent. Drives the badge and the chips. Omitted: the client counts the lines it has.

omitted.description: kind log: lines before the first one sent, which the producer left out (the log parser sends the last 200). Shown as “1,840 earlier lines not sent”, with Open File when `path` is set.

filter.description: kind log: show level chips (All · Errors · Warnings) that filter the lines on this device. Nothing is sent.

path.description: A workspace-relative path on the gateway the code comes from or is meant for: Sync/Reconnect.swift. A tap opens it (hermes-file:) in the Inspector on iPad and Mac, Quick Look on iPhone, at `range`.

range.description: The lines of `path` the snippet shows; the gutter numbers start at start. Omit for a suggestion that isn’t in the file yet (numbers start at 1).

command.description: kind output: the command that printed it, shown first after a $. Never with secrets: the plugin redacts and rejects them.

state.description: ok: it ran and did what was expected (exit 0); warning: it ran, with warnings; critical: it failed or threw. Drawn as the state glyph before the label.

label.description: The result line: “Ran in 0.4 s”, “Failed · exit 1 · 12.4 s”. The client builds it from exit_code and duration when it’s omitted.

exit_code.description: The process exit code, when there is one.

output.description: What it printed or returned, shown after the label in monospace: “0.25 0.5 1 2 4 5”. Longer output is its own code widget with kind output.

where.description: Where it ran, when that matters: “on Studio Mac”, “in a sandbox”.

result.description: The result of really running the code. Omit it when the code wasn’t run: never a guessed output.
